versions.content: Service Name Ecu M_ Set Clock Syntax Std_ Return Type Ecu M_ Set Clock ( Ecu M_ User Type user, Ecu M_ Time Type time ) Service ID [hex] 0x27 Sync/ Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant Parameters (in) user User that wants to set the clock time Absolute time in seconds since battery connect. Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std _ Return Type E_ OK: The service has succeeded E_ NOT_ OK: The service failed Description Ecu M_ Set Clock sets the Ecu M clock time to the provided value. This API is useful for testing the alarm services; Alarms that take days to expire can be tested. Ecu M_ Set Clock is part of the ECU Manager Module port interface. Available via Ecu M.h
